title: Plus One
statement: The array holds the decimal digits of a non-negative integer, most significant first. Add one and return the resulting digits.
constraints: no leading zeros except the number 0 itself
hints: Do not convert to an integer; the number can exceed every built-in type.
Walk from the last digit backwards. A digit below 9 just increments and you are finished.
A 9 becomes 0 and carries. If you fall off the front still carrying, the answer is one digit longer and starts with 1.
